sections.role: Addressing objections and providing immediate value
sections.headline: Accident Recovery FAQ
sections.subheadline: Answers to the most common questions we hear from accident victims in Texas.

items.title: How much is my car accident case worth?
items.description: Case value depends on medical bills, lost wages, pain and suffering, and insurance limits. We provide a detailed valuation during your free review.

items.title: How long do I have to file a claim in Texas?
items.description: Generally, the statute of limitations is two years from the date of the accident, but certain factors can shorten this window significantly.

items.title: Do I have to go to court?
items.description: Most cases settle out of court. However, we prepare every case as if it is going to trial to ensure the insurance company takes us seriously.

items.title: What if the other driver didn't have insurance?
items.description: We can explore Uninsured Motorist (UM) coverage and other avenues to ensure you are still compensated for your injuries.
